content.short: Plume is a modular Layer 1 blockchain purpose-built for RWAfi, featuring an institutional tokenization engine.
content.description: Plume Network is a pioneering modular Layer 1 blockchain specifically engineered to facilitate the seamless onboarding and trading of all real-world assets (RWAs). The platform features a built-in tokenization engine called Arc, which handles institutional-grade compliance and identity verification directly at the protocol level. This approach eliminates the complex logistical barriers typically associated with moving physical assets on-chain, enabling an efficient RWAfi ecosystem. Powered by the PLUME token, the network provides a secure environment for real estate and credit.
